# LiteLLM's LlmProviders enum -- every value LiteLLM can put in a spend
# record's custom_llm_provider field, and every route prefix it can put
# before the slash in a model string. This is the INPUT domain that
# litellmProviderToGenAISystem in provider.go must make a decision about
# (map it, or deliberately leave it unmapped so it surfaces as "unknown").
#
# Captured from litellm 1.93.0 on 2026-08-01 with:
#
#   docker exec wiretap-litellm-1 /app/.venv/bin/python -c \
#     "from litellm.types.utils import LlmProviders; print('\n'.join(sorted(p.value for p in LlmProviders)))"
#
# *** REFRESH THIS FILE ON EVERY LITELLM UPGRADE ***
# TestProviderTableCoversLiteLLMProviders fails the moment this file and
# the table+exceptions disagree, which is the point: a LiteLLM upgrade
# that adds providers forces a conscious mapping decision instead of
# silently emitting the fallback for them (which is how Ollama-served
# documents came to be labelled "groq" -- see notes.md).
